name: Point 4D Convolution
description: A convolution operation designed for raw point cloud videos. It operates on a spatio-temporal local region defined by spatial radius (rs) and temporal radius (rt). It uses a parameterized function to generate kernels based on input 4D displacements and point features, thereby embedding local structures and subsampling points (using FPS and temporal stride) for the subsequent transformer.

evidence.quote_or_summary: We propose a point 4D convolution to embed the spatio-temporal local structures presented in a point cloud video... our point 4D convolution is directly performed on raw points without voxelization...

Based on temporal radius (rt), temporal stride (st), spatial radius (rs) and spatial subsampling rate (ss), we construct a few spatio-temporal local areas. Our point 4D convolution encodes each spatio-temporal local area to a feature vector.

name: Transformer
description: Applies self-attention to the embedded spatio-temporal local features (from the point 4D convolution). It merges related local areas based on attention weights to capture global appearance and motion information across the entire video, avoiding explicit point tracking.

evidence.quote_or_summary: ...we propose to utilize the transformer to capture the global appearance and motion information across the entire video. By performing self-attention, related local areas are adaptively merged based on the attention weight.

Given I, we aim to merge related local areas based on their similarities... we perform self-attention on I... the softmax function is performed on the entire video, which is referred to as video-level self-attention in this paper.

name: 4D Coordinate and Local Feature Embedding
description: Combines the 4D coordinates (x, y, z, t) of a local area's anchor point with its encoded local feature (from point 4D convolution) using a linear layer to form the input representation for the transformer.

evidence.quote_or_summary: Therefore, we combine anchor coordinates, i.e., (x, y, z, t), and local area features as the input to our transformer, I(x,y,z,t) = Wi · (x, y, z, t)T + F′(x,y,z)t, ...

name: Feature Propagation for Segmentation
description: Used in the 4D semantic segmentation task. After the transformer, this component recovers the subsampled N' points back to the original N points by interpolating features, followed by an MLP for point-wise predictions.

evidence.quote_or_summary: After the transformer, feature propagation layers recover the subsampled N′ points to the original N points by interpolating features. Finally, an MLP maps interpolated features to point predictions.
